proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f _
  have hrefl : ∀ (g : AddCircle T → ℂ) (n : ℤ), fourierCoeff (fun x => g (-x)) n = fourierCoeff g (-n) := by
    intro g n
    simp only [fourierCoeff, smul_eq_mul, neg_neg]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self (fun t => fourier n t * g t)]
    congr 1
    funext t
    congr 1
    rw [fourier_apply, fourier_apply]
    congr 2
    simp
  refine ⟨fun h n => ?_, fun h n => ?_, fun h n => ?_⟩
  · have e : fourierCoeff f n = (starRingEnd ℂ) (fourierCoeff f (-n)) := by
      simp only [fourierCoeff, smul_eq_mul, neg_neg]
      rw [← integral_conj]
      congr 1
      funext t
      rw [map_mul, h t, ← fourier_neg]
    rw [e, Complex.conj_conj]
  · rw [← hrefl f n]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact h x
  · rw [← hrefl f n]
    have e : (fun x => f (-x)) = fun x => (-1 : ℂ) * f x := by
      funext x; rw [h x]; ring
    rw [e, fourierCoeff.const_mul]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f : AddCircle T → ℂ), MeasureTheory.Integrable f AddCircle.haarAddCircle → ((∀ x, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f x) = f x) → ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff f (-n) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (fourierCoeff f n)) ∧ ((∀ x, f (-x) = f x) → ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff f (-n) = fourierCoeff f n) ∧ ((∀ x, f (-x) = -f x) → ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff f (-n) = -fourierCoeff f n)
